Who we are

The Sip'd Experience

More than a drink cart — we create an experience. Sip'd & Co. was created from a shared love between two sisters for beautiful drinks, thoughtful details, and celebrations that make every guest feel included. From the first pour to the final photo, we bring flavour, style, and genuine care to every event.

Halal, alcohol-free and inclusive

Every drink on our menu is completely alcohol-free — not as an alternative, but as the main experience. Whether we're serving at a wedding, Eid celebration, corporate event or intimate gathering, every guest can enjoy something exciting, elevated and beautifully made.

Rooted in our community

Sip'd & Co. began in the GTA and continues to grow through the support of the communities we serve. From cultural galas and university events to weddings and family celebrations, every booking feels personal to us. When you choose Sip'd, you're supporting a local, woman-owned small business that genuinely cares about your event.

Designed to be remembered

Our setup is more than a place to grab a drink — it becomes part of your event's atmosphere. We thoughtfully coordinate every detail, from your custom menu and cup stickers to the colours, garnishes and presentation of each drink. Beautiful in person and even better in photos.

Service that feels personal

Great drinks matter, but so does the way your guests are treated. We arrive prepared, pay attention to the little details and make sure every guest feels welcomed and taken care of. That's the Sip'd experience.

Halal-friendly Community-rooted GTA based Women-run Obsessively delicious

Coffee Cart

Chai Bar

What's included

What Each Package Offers

The Cart & Setup

Our fully styled mobile cart arrives ready to go — no bare tables, no makeshift setup. Just a beautiful station that fits right into your event's look.

A custom-built menu from our matcha, coffee, and mocktail offerings — themed names, colours, and flavours designed around your event.

On-Site Team

Our team handles every pour from start to finish — friendly, attentive, and dressed to match your event, so you can focus on your guests.

Cups, Garnishes & Details
